describe: The image shows a cut-out picture of a silver alarm clock with two bells sitting on top of a bundle of red dynamite sticks bound with a black band. Coiled blue and green wire loops wrap around the right side. The clock face is white with black hour marks. Colours are bright red, silver-grey, white, blue and green, with moderate contrast and studio-style lighting. Transparent background. The clock, dynamite and wire layout must stay exactly in place.
